title: 第25章 黄轩猜测第26章 云家投资
slug: 灵源仙途我养的灵兽太懂感恩了
content_zh:
顾安连续遇到两件糟心事，感觉这云国小会简直有毒，不去也罢，就打算回白镜湖。
踏出客栈门，阳光正好，天净如瓷。
顾安深吸一口气，才感觉心情变好很多。
“顾师弟，这是要去哪啊！”一道温和的声音响起，转头一看，是黄轩师兄。
对于这个溢价购买紫云雁蛋的师兄，顾安还是很有好感的，笑着回道：“我这储物袋中的灵石都被云国小会给骗光了，再不走，恐怕里衣都不剩了！”
黄轩哑然失笑，觉得这个师弟还真是个妙人，自己像他这么大的时候，可不好意思把口袋空空说的这么理直气壮。
“那师弟没事的话，不如一起去喝杯酒？”黄轩哈哈一笑，邀请顾安去喝酒。
顾安也想结交一下这位黄师兄，于是欣然答应。
不一会，两人来到福云楼，要了几碟菜，开了坛陈年杏花酒，虽无灵气，却也有滋有味。
木筷几回起落，瓷碗空了又满，二人聊的起兴。
顾安三碗酒下肚，对着黄轩大吐苦水：“黄师兄不知道，那韩庚忒不是东西，非得拉我下水。”
话匣子一打开，顾安就没了顾忌，索性把今天的事给黄轩仔仔细细的说了一遍。
“你说什么，韩庚弄到了屠氏酒谱？”黄轩有些错愕，张大嘴说道：“这韩庚倒是奸滑，人家屠氏被屠他不动如山，这发死人财，倒是侵略如火！”
顾安听的有些迷糊：“黄师兄此言什么意思？”
黄轩将碗中酒一饮而尽，冷笑一声：“顾师弟有所不知，我青元宗收人灵税，就要护人家性命，人家传音符都到他府邸了，他却当没看到，真是令人不齿！”
听闻此言，顾安对韩庚印象更差，打定主意以后不与此人打交道。
两人对韩庚都膈应的慌，不再提他。
酒又过了一巡，黄轩一脸神秘的伏过身子，低声说道。
“顾师弟你可知道，咱们青元宗啊，可能要乱了。”
顾安一愣，筷子顿了下来，要乱了？发生什么了？

顾安心中好奇，于也是低下头，小声问道：“黄师兄细说，我没听说啊！”
黄轩一脸便秘的表情，恨恨道：“还不是那劫修之事，王师叔去御兽宗大开杀戒，人家当然要报复回来啊！”
“啊？”顾安惊疑一声，劫修的事他知道，王师叔杀御兽宗弟子他也知道，可他之前也没深想。
是了，都是金丹宗门，御兽宗弟子被人闯进家门里宰了，怎么可能不报复。
“啊什么呀，你再想想，我青元宗和御兽宗哪里接壤？”黄轩急切的拍了拍桌子。
“云国和幽国啊，你是说……”顾安反应过来，失声道。
“对啊，接下来云国绝对是最乱的！而我们这些云国驻守也是最危险的啊！”黄轩一脸的痛心疾首，为自己的处境深深担忧。
坏了，我这成前线了。
顾安欲哭无泪，他只想安安静静地养灵兽修仙啊！怎么就遇上这种事啊！赶忙问道：“黄师兄可有什么解决之法？不瞒你说，师弟生性胆小，可应付不过来这场面呐！”
黄轩长叹一口气说道：“师兄我也害怕呀！为今之计只有找找关系，看看能不能放弃任务，调回宗内，师弟可有门路？”
顾安略一沉吟，也不隐瞒，“我能接到这个任务全靠庶务堂张管事出力，不知他有没有能力把我召回去？我回去就修书一封！”
黄轩眼睛一亮，分管任务的管事，那倒是真能使得上劲，赶忙说道：“顾师弟可否帮我也问问，事成之后，师兄自有一份心意。”
“当然，绝不会让师弟难做，张管事那也会有一份谢仪，不会少于这个数。”
content_en:
Gu An encountered two bad things in succession. He felt that the Yun Guo Xiaohui was simply poisonous. He decided not to go and planned to return to Baijing Lake.
Stepping out of the inn door, the sun is just right and the sky is as clear as porcelain.
Gu An took a deep breath and felt that his mood had improved a lot.
"Junior Brother Gu, where are we going!" A gentle voice sounded. He turned around and saw that it was Senior Brother Huang Xuan.
Gu An still had a good impression of this senior who bought Ziyun Goose Eggs at a premium, and replied with a smile: "All the spiritual stones in my storage bag have been deceived by the Yun Elementary School. If I don't leave, I'm afraid I won't have any clothes left!"
Huang Xuan burst into laughter, feeling that this junior brother was really a wonderful person. When he was as old as him, he was embarrassed to say so confidently that his pockets were empty.
"If junior brother is fine, why don't we go have a drink together?" Huang Xuan laughed and invited Gu An to have a drink.
Gu An also wanted to make friends with Senior Brother Huang, so he readily agreed.
After a while, the two came to Fuyun Tower, ordered a few dishes, and opened a jar of aged apricot blossom wine. Although it was not spiritual, it was still delicious.
The wooden chopsticks rose and fell several times, the porcelain bowl became empty and full, and the two chatted happily.
Gu An finished three bowls of wine and vomited his bitterness to Huang Xuan: "Senior Brother Huang doesn't know that Han Geng is not a thing and he has to drag me into the water."
As soon as the conversation started, Gu An lost all scruples and simply told Huang Xuanzai what happened today in detail.
"What are you talking about, Han Geng got the Tu family's wine recipe?" Huang Xuan was a little surprised, and opened his mouth and said: "This Han Geng is really cunning. When the Tu family was slaughtered, he could not move like a mountain. This is killing people and making money, but his invasion is like fire!"
Gu An was a little confused when he heard this: "What does Senior Brother Huang mean by this?"
Huang Xuan drank the wine in the bowl in one gulp and sneered: "Junior brother Gu doesn't know something. Our Qingyuan Sect collects soul taxes and has to protect their lives. People's transmission notes have arrived at his residence, but he pretended not to see it. It's really disgusting!"
After hearing this, Gu An had a worse impression of Han Geng and made up his mind not to deal with this person in the future.
Both of them were in a panic towards Han Geng and stopped mentioning him.
After drinking for another round, Huang Xuan leaned over with a mysterious look on his face and whispered.
"Junior Brother Gu, do you know that our Qingyuan Sect may be in chaos."
Gu An was stunned and paused with his chopsticks. Was it going to be messy? what happens?
Gu An was curious, so he lowered his head and asked in a low voice: "Senior Brother Huang, tell me more, I haven't heard about it!"
Huang Xuan had a constipated expression on his face and said bitterly: "It's not about the calamity repair. Uncle Wang went to the Beast Control Sect and went on a killing spree. Of course he will come back with revenge!"
"Ah?" Gu An was surprised. He knew about Jie Xiu, and he also knew about Uncle Wang's killing of the disciples of the Beast Control Sect, but he hadn't thought about it deeply before.
Yes, they are all from the Jindan Sect. The disciples of the Beast Control Sect were broken into their homes and slaughtered. How could they not take revenge?
"Ah, what, think about it again, where do our Qingyuan Sect and the Beast Control Sect connect?" Huang Xuan patted the table eagerly.
"Yun Guo and You Guo, you mean..." Gu An reacted and lost his voice.
"Yes, the Yun Kingdom will definitely be the most chaotic next! And those of us stationed in the Yun Kingdom will also be the most dangerous!" Huang Xuan looked distressed and deeply worried about his situation.
Damn it, I'm on the front line.
Gu An was about to cry but had no tears. He just wanted to quietly raise spiritual beasts and cultivate immortality! Why did this happen? He hurriedly asked: "Senior Brother Huang, do you have any solution? To be honest, Junior Brother is timid by nature and cannot handle this situation!"
Huang Xuan let out a long sigh and said, "Senior brother, I'm scared too! The only plan for now is to find connections and see if we can give up the mission and be transferred back to the sect. Is there any way for me, junior brother?"
Gu An pondered for a moment and didn't hide anything, "I was able to receive this task only because of the efforts of Manager Zhang from the General Affairs Hall. I wonder if he has the ability to recall me back? I'll fix a book when I get back!"
Huang Xuan's eyes lit up. The steward in charge of the task could really make peopleEnergetic, he hurriedly said: "Junior Brother Gu, if you can help me, please ask. After the matter is completed, Senior Brother will have his own thoughts."
"Of course, I will never make it difficult for Junior Brother. Manager Zhang will also have a token of thanks, no less than this amount."
